figures.caption: Architecture of the three reservoirs. All three read out the same N(N+1)/2 second moments of N homodyne records through a linear ridge readout. AD differs from NA only by the red outcome-to-basis link (g != 0). Schematic; no data.

Red: outcome-to-basis links that exist only in R_AD (tap record of clock k-1 to teleportation basis of clock k). Dashed blue: dependence through the quantum state (present in all MB reservoirs). Teleportation outcomes m feed only byproduct displacements and are never used to choose a basis. Severing every red edge gives R_NA exactly. Schematic; no data.

(a) Forbidden/allowed coefficient ratios from Cauchy contours on the exact NA and CV engines (8 instances: N in [3, 5], 2 realizations, base and lossy conditions); deterministic, no error bars. (b) Exact NA kernel leakage under homodyne-angle jitter (Gauss-Hermite recursion, one realization, N=5). (c) Pathwise AD c31(1,0) at g=0.4 vs FD step (512 CRN paths; differences are paired, so Monte Carlo noise cancels). (d) First clock at which any of 128 trajectories escapes (inf = none within the run).
Mean over realizations (3 realizations per cell, 2048 trajectories, 200 clocks); 'div' = at least one realization diverged (non-fading).

Benettin exponents per clock, averaged over trajectories and realizations (3 realizations per cell, 2048 trajectories, 200 clocks). CI and CR are different couplings: CI shares innovations (synthetic), CR is filter stability.
U-statistic estimate (unbiased; can be negative from noise), 4096 CRN paths in 16 blocks per realization, 3 realizations; g=0 column is the Monte Carlo null (exact value 0 by Theorem 2).

N=5, 3 realizations per cell, 2048 trajectories, 200 clocks. Dashed: zero crossing of Lambda_ch (ensemble edge); dotted: zero crossing of lambda_CI (trajectory edge), when inside the scanned range. Error bars: 95% CI from max(Monte Carlo jackknife, between-realization) SE. Single-size crossovers are finite-size adaptive crossovers, not phase transitions.

Pilot: 10 realizations x 2 inputs x 2 innovation replicates (40 paired units), 512 shots, train/test 3000/1500. Points: realization means; black bars: mean +- 1.96 SE across realizations (left); hierarchical-bootstrap 95% CI (2000 resamples) (middle). Dashed line: baseline population floor NMSE = 1 (Theorems 1-2). '_exact'/'_rb' = ideal (infinite-shot) features. Right: secondary tasks, means only, not part of any claim.
5 realizations (input 0, replicate 0), g=0.2; mean +- 1.96 SE of the paired difference to NA across realizations. C7 and D1 use exact (ideal) features, the most favourable setting for the baselines.

Witness NMSE against injected squeezing resource, pilot means. CV_photon has the MB squeezing budget (accounting 2); x2 = a second independent reservoir (2x modes and features). Dashed: baseline population floor. No error bars: means only (see Fig. 9 for uncertainty).

Cross-check of the two kernel measures for the 9 K* components at g=0.2: derivative norms from 3 realizations (x 4096 paths); capacities averaged over 40 pilot units. Capacities below ~0.005 (features / train length) are within the finite-sample noise floor.

Monte Carlo power (1000 simulations per point) of the preregistered analysis, with variance components from the pilot (10 realizations); design 2 inputs x 1 replicate per realization; vertical line: planned n_confirm=150.

Stage-wise projection from throughput measured in this preflight run (40 pilot units; t = a + b N^3 fit over N in [3, 5]); red line: AVAILABLE_RUNTIME_HOURS. Uncertainty: 90th-percentile/median unit time (1.04) x 1.25 extrapolation margin.
